name: Precision Blast
body:
Prerequisite(s): Infusion class ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use a kinetic blast that affects more than a single target or square, you may select a square within its area to not be affected by your blast.

For each 2 points of burn you have, you may select an additional square to be unaffected by your blast.
